provenance: User-reported outputs from earlier independent Google Colab run; NOT reexecuted or verified from a model checkpoint in this repository.

synthetic_comparison.protocol: 4000 samples: 2000 original unfiltered non-overlapping test windows (ASSUMED normal) + 2000 paired modified windows (synthetic anomaly); stronger artificial perturbations.

limitations: No verified binary anomaly labels in the original DALTON activity annotations.
Original windows are assumed normal in controlled synthetic evaluation but some may be unusual.
Injected shifts/noise/spikes are relatively strong and expressed in normalized units.
Baseline and LSTM use different representations and training sample counts.
This repository does not contain the earlier trained 15,242-parameter checkpoint.
